```{r pressure, echo=FALSE}
allproteins <- bind_rows(cisprotein, transprotein)
```


```{r}
# Step 3: define your 30 CpGs and cluster mapping
cluster1 <- c("cg01409343","cg18942579","cg16936953","cg12054453","cg00490406",
              "cg01059398","cg21979287","cg08818207","cg27537252","cg03425812",
              "cg12828896","cg03957124","cg16306654","cg03753191","cg07878065",
              "cg04176813","cg07839457","cg16411857")

cluster2 <- c("cg23387863","cg23904266","cg09249800","cg11699125","cg14496081",
              "cg07830828","cg02068052")

cluster3 <- c("cg24741430","cg10636246","cg13575798","cg26140475","cg09801824")

cpg_clusters <- data.frame(
  CpG = c(cluster1, cluster2, cluster3),
  cluster = c(rep(1, length(cluster1)), 
              rep(2, length(cluster2)), 
              rep(3, length(cluster3)))

)


KTR_proteins <- allproteins %>% 
  filter(pQTM %in% cpg_clusters$CpG) %>%
  left_join(cpg_clusters, by = c("pQTM" = "CpG"))

KTR_proteins <- KTR_proteins %>%
  mutate(direction = ifelse(beta > 0, "positive", "negative"))

KTR_proteins_ordered <- KTR_proteins %>%
  arrange(cluster, pQTM, direction)

pos_proteins <- KTR_proteins_ordered %>%
  filter(direction == "positive") %>%
  select(pQTM, cluster, SYMBOL, SeqID, beta)

neg_proteins <- KTR_proteins_ordered %>%
  filter(direction == "negative") %>%
  select(pQTM, cluster, SYMBOL, SeqID, beta)

```

#Save as cvs
```{r}
write.csv(pos_proteins,"R:/ARIC/Users/yl13544/02_EWAS_Tryptophan/05 Protein/positive_protein_cpg.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(neg_proteins,"R:/ARIC/Users/yl13544/02_EWAS_Tryptophan/05 Protein/negative_protein_cpg.csv", row.names = FALSE)

```

```{r}

# CpG cluster mapping
cluster1 <- c("cg01409343","cg18942579","cg16936953","cg12054453","cg00490406",
              "cg01059398","cg21979287","cg08818207","cg27537252","cg03425812",
              "cg12828896","cg03957124","cg16306654","cg03753191","cg07878065",
              "cg04176813","cg07839457","cg16411857")

cluster2 <- c("cg23387863","cg23904266","cg09249800","cg11699125","cg14496081",
              "cg07830828","cg02068052")

cluster3 <- c("cg24741430","cg10636246","cg13575798","cg26140475","cg09801824")

cpg_clusters <- data.frame(
  CpG = c(cluster1, cluster2, cluster3),
  cluster = c(rep(1, length(cluster1)), 
              rep(2, length(cluster2)), 
              rep(3, length(cluster3)))
)

cpg_order <- c(cluster1, cluster2, cluster3)

# Helper to collapse labels
collapse_labels <- function(x) {
  x <- unique(na.omit(x))
  if (length(x) == 0) "" else paste(x, collapse = "; ")
}

# ---- POSITIVE ----
pos_wide <- pos_proteins %>%
  mutate(protein_display = ifelse(!is.na(SYMBOL) & SYMBOL != "", SYMBOL, seqID)) %>%
  group_by(pQTM) %>%
  summarize(positive_proteins = collapse_labels(protein_display), .groups = "drop")

# ---- NEGATIVE ----
neg_wide <- neg_proteins %>%
  mutate(protein_display = ifelse(!is.na(SYMBOL) & SYMBOL != "", SYMBOL, seqID)) %>%
  group_by(pQTM) %>%
  summarize(negative_proteins = collapse_labels(protein_display), .groups = "drop")

# ---- MERGE + ORDER ----
collapsed <- full_join(pos_wide, neg_wide, by = "pQTM") %>%
  left_join(cpg_clusters, by = c("pQTM" = "CpG")) %>%
  mutate(
    pQTM = factor(pQTM, levels = cpg_order),
    positive_proteins = replace_na(positive_proteins, ""),
    negative_proteins = replace_na(negative_proteins, "")
  ) %>%
  arrange(cluster, pQTM) %>%
  rename(CpG = pQTM, cluster_id = cluster)

# View result
head(collapsed)

write.csv(collapsed,"R:/ARIC/Users/yl13544/02_EWAS_Tryptophan/05 Protein/collapsed_protein_cpg.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```
